summary: Backend-only testing of the new POST /api/events/dedupe endpoint and the event-name normalization logic pulled from GitHub. Created /app/backend/tests/test_events_dedupe.py (67 tests: unit tests for _canonical_stroke_short/normalize_stroke_name/normalize_course_str/normalize_age_group/normalize_event_name + API tests for dedupe dry-run, real merge, idempotency, canonical GET /api/events, and create_event canonicalization/duplicate reuse). 66/67 passed. The reported 405 issue is FIXED: POST /api/events/dedupe?dry_run=true returns 200 with {dry_run, total_events:7, canonical_groups:7, merge_count, normalize_count, athletes_updated, events_after}; non-dry-run adds remaining_events/remaining_standards/remaining_times and is idempotent. Duplicate-create reuse works (variant labels 'Girls 200 Yard Freestyle 15 & 16'/'FR'/'Yards'/'15 & 16' returned the existing event id, event count unchanged). Non-canonical name 'Boys 50 Yard Butterfly SCY' normalized to '50 Fly' with stroke Butterfly, course SCY, ageGroup 13-14 and persisted. One real bug found in create_event distance inference. All test-created events were cleaned up (DB back to the 7 seed events).

minor.issue: Distance inference bug: when distance=0 (falsy), create_event runs its own regex on the RAW name before age-label stripping, so payload {name:'11-12 Boys 100 Backstroke', distance:0, course:'SCY'} was stored as distance=12, name='12 Back'. Fix: strip age-group labels first or reuse normalize_event_name's parsing (it correctly returns '100 Back').

Loose substring matching: bare 'im' matches any name containing im/Swim/Time/Prelim -> classified as IM ('100 Free Swim Time Trial' -> '100 IM'; 'Prelim 50 Free' -> IM). Same risk for 2-letter tokens 'fr', 'bk', 'br', 'fl'. This matters because normalize_event_name is applied to OCR/heat-sheet extracted event names (server.py ~1479, ~1532). Use word-boundary regex instead of `in`.

Unhandled labels pass through unchanged: '14U' -> '14U', '16U' -> '16U', '19 & Over' -> '19 & Over' (no 13-14 / 15-16 / open mapping), which can create separate canonical groups for the same real bracket.

Destructive endpoint (deletes events, remaps timeEntries/qualifyingStandards/athletes) has no auth/session check - callable anonymously from the public URL. Consider requiring an authenticated coach/admin session.
All Mongo calls are sync pymongo inside async handlers (blocks the event loop); the merge loop also issues per-duplicate update_many/delete_one instead of a bulk write.

action_items: Fix create_event distance inference for distance=0/omitted: strip age-group labels (e.g. '11-12') before extracting distance, or delegate to normalize_event_name.
Replace substring stroke matching in _canonical_stroke_short with word-boundary regex to avoid 'Swim'/'Time'/'Prelim' -> IM misclassification.
Extend normalize_age_group to cover 14U/16U/19&Over style labels.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2166 lines - split routers (events, athletes, times, standards, teams, OCR) into modules.
Normalization helpers are defined ~line 1541 but used at line 240 (works only because calls are at request time); move helpers above route definitions or into a utils module.
dedupe_events performs multi-collection mutations without a transaction; a mid-run failure leaves events deleted but selectedEventIds unremapped.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created events '50 Fly 13-14', '200 Free 15-16', a duplicate '50 Free 11-12' variant and one mis-parsed '12 Back'; all deleted by the class teardown fixture. DB verified back to the 7 seed events.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md - demo login buttons only, no passwords; not needed for these endpoints (no auth required).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_events_dedupe.py -v` for regression on dedupe + normalization. conftest.py provides base_url/api_client/created_event_ids/cleanup fixtures. Only remaining known failure is test_distance_inferred_from_name_with_age_label (real create_event bug, not a test issue).
rca_of_the_issue: 405 no longer reproduces - POST /api/events/dedupe is registered and returns 200 for both dry_run=true and the real run; GET on the same path correctly returns 405. Root cause of the one failing test: create_event's local distance regex (server.py ~245) scans the raw event name before age-group labels are stripped, so '11-12' is matched and max(11,12)=12 becomes the distance for SCY.
